title: Epic: Cognition intake firewall for untrusted inbound content
description:
Summary
Build a companion-native cognition intake firewall so untrusted content can arrive without automatically entering prompt, memory, wiki, persona, trust state, or tool execution as raw cognition.

Why
The current code has several strong primitives but no single membrane. SubstrateMessage and Attachment carry content and attachment paths but no structured source/risk/quarantine state (src/shared/contracts/runtime.ts:216). Discord document ingest quarantines risky files and hashes withheld content, but clean parsed text is appended into prompt-visible parsed_attachment_text blocks (src/channels/discord/file-ingest.ts:266, src/channels/discord/file-ingest.ts:482). Web fetch sanitization wraps fetched text as untrusted content (src/boundary/gateway/sanitize.ts:86). Tool observations are truncated/masked but do not carry risk labels into later prompt/tool gates (src/core/session/tool-observation.ts:132, src/core/session/tool-observation.ts:222). Memory CogSec candidacy rejects risky memory writes, but it is not a unified inbound firewall (src/core/cogsec/memory-candidacy.ts:122).

Scope
- Define one typed intake envelope for inbound chat, attachments, fetched web content, parsed docs, tool observations, model/subagent/shard outputs, and future public/broadcast surfaces.
- Preserve raw content only behind quarantine/forensic references when policy requires it.
- Present prompt-safe summaries or labels instead of raw text for untrusted/high-risk content.
- Make prompt, memory, wiki, trust/persona, and tool gates consume the same risk/release state.
- Emit audit events for classify/quarantine/release/block decisions.

Non-goals
- No Beam/Jido rewrite.
- No public Twitch implementation in this epic except as a future source class the contract can represent.
- Do not relax existing capability, trust, gateway, or memory gates.
acceptance_criteria:
- Every inbound content item has source/channel/trust/provenance/risk/quarantine or release metadata before it can be considered for prompt assembly or persistence.
- Raw untrusted/high-risk content is withheld from prompt/memory/wiki/tool-driving context unless explicitly released by policy/operator review.
- Prompt-visible representation is safe summary/label/object metadata, not raw hazardous payload, for quarantined items.
- Prompt, memory, wiki, trust/persona, and tool gates use the intake envelope rather than ad hoc per-surface checks.
- CogSec/audit logs record classify, quarantine, release, block, and gate-consumption decisions without leaking sealed payloads.
- Cross-surface tests prove high-risk external content cannot become instructions, durable memories, wiki facts, persona changes, trust changes, or tool-driving context.
- npm run lint and targeted tests pass before closing implementation children.
notes:
2026-07-02 operator planning chat: firewall stays important but deliberately deferred briefly while core stabilization (E5/E7.1 wave, epics psfn-framework-4yb3/ihfp) lands. When built, it must also apply to inter-companion communication (psfn-framework-8pyl) — even high-trust companions need protection so one infected companion cannot spread bad context east-west through a cluster.
2026-07-08 operator backlog triage: Aim at Sprint 10; cognition intake firewall remains active Sprint 10 work.

title: Define typed intake envelope and source/risk contract
description:
Summary
Define the typed intake envelope that all inbound content surfaces use before content reaches prompt assembly, memory extraction, wiki writes, persona/trust mutation, or tool-driving context.

Current evidence
SubstrateMessage has id, channelId, channelType, author, content, attachments, timestamp, DM flag, and routing but no source class, risk labels, quarantine/release state, or safe summary fields (src/shared/contracts/runtime.ts:216). Attachment similarly has URL/contentType/name/localPath/dataBase64/parsedTextPath but no provenance hash or quarantine state (src/shared/contracts/runtime.ts:231). ToolObservationMetadata records tool name, call id, truncation, and context summary but no risk/quarantine fields (src/core/session/tool-observation.ts:20). CogSec event records already model safeAgentSummary and sealed refs, which should inform the intake shape (src/core/cogsec/events.ts:72).

Scope
- Add a shared contract for sourceClass, channel visibility/trust snapshot, provenance refs, raw content ref/hash, safe summary, risk labels, quarantine status, release authority, and allowed downstream gates.
- Cover chat text, attachments, parsed docs, fetched web content, binary fetch metadata, tool observations, model/subagent/shard outputs, and future broadcast/public firehose summaries.
- Keep raw payloads out of normal prompt-visible fields when the envelope says quarantined or summary-only.
- Define deterministic defaults for unknown/missing source metadata: fail closed to untrusted/summary-only.

Non-goals
- Do not wire every adapter in this bead.
- Do not implement classifier logic beyond types, validators, and helper constructors.
acceptance_criteria:
- A shared TypeScript contract exists for intake source/provenance/risk/quarantine/release state.
- Constructors/validators reject malformed states and fail closed for missing source/risk metadata.
- SubstrateMessage, Attachment, and tool observation pathways can carry the envelope without raw content masquerading as normal trusted content.
- Contract tests cover trusted DM, semi-private group, public/broadcast, external web/doc, tool output, and model/subagent output cases.
- Docs or inline contract comments define which downstream gates may consume each state.
- npm run lint and targeted contract tests pass.

title: Wire intake classifier and quarantine across inbound surfaces
description:
Summary
Apply the shared intake envelope/classification path to all current inbound content surfaces so unsafe raw content is represented as metadata or safe summary before companion cognition.

Current evidence
Discord document ingest already classifies and quarantines risky attachments before parsing (src/channels/discord/file-ingest.ts:266), but safe parsed text is inserted raw into parsed_attachment_text prompt tags (src/channels/discord/file-ingest.ts:482). Web text is sanitized and tagged as untrusted (src/boundary/gateway/sanitize.ts:86), while binary fetches and tool observations do not share the same envelope. API and Telegram attachment paths are separate from Discord document quarantine and need parity review. Public/broadcast history can be wrapped as untrusted_context, but the wrapper does not escape closing tags (src/core/session/manager-primitives.ts:982).

Scope
- Wire deterministic checks plus optional small reviewer/classifier into Discord, API, Telegram, web fetch, binary fetch, parsed document, tool observation, and model/subagent/shard-output intake.
- Convert high-risk items to quarantined safe-summary objects with sealed raw refs/hashes.
- Escape or structurally encode all prompt-visible untrusted payloads, including currently clean parsed documents and public/broadcast context wrappers.
- Preserve existing Discord file quarantine behavior and web URL/SSRF policy while moving output into the common envelope.
- Emit classify/quarantine/release audit events without raw payload leaks.

Non-goals
- No Twitch firehose implementation here.
- No changes to downstream memory/wiki/tool gate behavior beyond producing the labels they will later consume.
acceptance_criteria:
- Discord, API, Telegram, web text, web binary metadata, tool observations, and model/subagent/shard output surfaces produce intake envelopes.
- Risky scripts/macros/archive/mime mismatch/prompt-injection/obfuscated/self-mod/trust-escalation/tool-hijack patterns are quarantined or summary-only by deterministic policy.
- Prompt-visible representations for untrusted content are escaped or structured so embedded closing tags/instructions cannot break the wrapper.
- Raw quarantined payloads are stored only behind sealed refs/hashes and are not included in turn prompt snapshots except as safe labels.
- Audit records are emitted for classify, quarantine, and release decisions.
- Cross-surface tests prove equivalent high-risk content is blocked or summarized consistently.
- npm run lint and targeted tests pass.

title: Make prompt, memory, wiki, and tool gates consume intake risk labels
description:
Summary
Route the intake envelope into the actual side-effect gates so risk/quarantine labels determine what can enter prompt, memory, wiki, persona/trust state, and tool execution.

Current evidence
Capability gates enforce tool permission tokens at dispatch (src/system/capabilities/gate.ts:64), and gateway approval enforces policy/approval around side effects (src/boundary/gateway/approval-boundary.ts:79). Memory retrieval and write paths have trust/CogSec gates (src/system/trust/policy.ts:209, src/core/cogsec/memory-candidacy.ts:122). Wiki writes require capability/provenance for imports (src/faculties/wiki/tools.ts:81, src/faculties/wiki/store.ts:176). None of these gates currently consume a common intake risk/quarantine label.

Scope
- Prompt gate: decide whether raw, escaped raw, safe summary, or metadata-only representation enters the current turn/session context.
- Memory gate: reject or review memory extraction/writes from quarantined or high-risk sources; preserve source/provenance labels.
- Wiki gate: require review/provenance for public/external/imported/generated content and block raw quarantined material from shared durable knowledge.
- Tool gate: prevent high-risk untrusted content from directly shaping side-effecting tool calls; integrate with capability, confirmation, and future pre-tool hook work.
- Persona/trust gate: block intake-sourced persona/trust/self-mod changes unless deterministic policy and operator approval allow them.
- Audit gate: record gate decisions with safe summaries and affected artifacts.

Non-goals
- Do not replace existing capability tiers, trust policy, or gateway approval queues.
- Do not implement dynamic relationship review policy here; integrate with it once built.
acceptance_criteria:
- Prompt assembly consumes intake labels and never sends quarantined raw content to the provider.
- Memory extraction/writer tests prove high-risk or quarantined content cannot create L2/core/profile memories.
- Wiki write/import tests prove untrusted external/public content requires provenance/review and cannot silently become shared durable knowledge.
- Tool dispatch/pre-tool policy tests prove high-risk intake cannot directly trigger or parameterize side-effecting tools without approval or summary-only handling.
- Persona/trust/self-mod attempts from untrusted intake are blocked or queued for operator review with audit records.
- CogSec/audit events include safe summaries, sealed refs, gate name, decision, and affected artifact ids without raw payload leaks.
- npm run lint and targeted gate tests pass.

title: Cognitive security firewall at the gateway
description: Deferred from sprint 10 multi-companion (review section 17). The gateway eventually hosts a cognitive security firewall inspecting inbound companion/peer traffic for injected commands, with the ability to cut a dangerous-actor channel completely. Until it exists, trust anchors on gateway routing (cross-cluster) and shared signing certificates (intra-cluster), plus existing backstops (no-reply/reply gating, fatigue, token revocation). Blocks full rollout of psfn-framework-s10d1. Source: working_docs/sprint-10-multi-companion.md section 7.
